note: Every tunable number in the game. All values are first guesses. Nothing in the code should hard-code these.
gameNameNote: Working title. The final name is not chosen yet, so read the name from here wherever it appears.

cards.sharedNumbersNote: Each game the two cards share a random number of numbers from sharedNumbersBetweenPlayerCards up to that plus extraSharedNumbersMax (so 7 to 12).

pause.pausesNote: How many times the player can pause in one game. null means no limit; a number (for example 1) brings the limit back.

shout.levelNote: The microphone level is turned into 0 to 1 by mapping dbFloor (silence) to dbCeiling (very loud). Test your shout sets the player's level to calibrationFactor times their best shout, between minThreshold and maxThreshold.

intro.note: Before the first number: the caller welcomes the player (a random line) while they look over their cards, then a 3, 2, 1 counts in the number circle.

credits.note: Closeness consolation: when a bot wins a stage, the player earns up to this share of the stage payout, scaled by how much of the pattern they had correctly marked.

animation.note: How things appear. Whole screens fade in calmly (the dark tense screens only fade; the bright ones also slide up a little). Small things such as the next-number card, the buttons and messages pop in with a little spring. All of it switches off when the phone's reduced-motion setting is on.

caller.note: How the animated caller behaves. He looks about every idleMinSeconds to idleMaxSeconds. Seasons turn on special looks around a date: month and day, daysEitherSide before and after. Add ?season=valentine to the address to preview one.

table.note: The regulars at the table. cardsPerRegular: how many cards each one plays. nearGoForFalseCall: a regular can only shout too soon when this close to the pattern. botSitOutCalls: how long a regular sits out after a false call. A regular's own reactionSeconds (in regulars.json) is how long they take to shout once they have it.

nights.name: The full night
nights.sub: Line, two lines, then full house
